title: Post-Deploy Strategy Audit — Zero Trades Despite Active Scanner
summary: After deploying commits 238bfb5→c293f22 (IS_PAPER dynamic mode fix, f-string syntax fix, sell pipeline hardening), the bot restarted clean on VPS. Scanner runs 3-min cycles finding 10-13 candidates per cycle. However ZERO trades have executed in 2.5 hours. Root cause: capital/chain mismatch — 90% of alpha signals are Ethereum (no wallet configured), Base gems score 60-76 (below Conservative min 68), Solana wallets have $0 balance.

what_happened.task: Verify bot is operational after sell pipeline overhaul
findings: Bot is scanning, scoring, and rejecting correctly — the pipeline works
Copy-trade alpha signals (MOVE, KITE, EIGEN, BIO, WLD, ZRO, LINK, SUSHI) are ALL Ethereum
Wallet config has Ethereum removed: chains=['base', 'arbitrum', 'solana']
Hyperliquid fallback fires but gem_score 61-66 < min 70 → blocked
Base gems (SpaceX=75.9, MOCA=63.2) exist but most below Conservative min_gem_score=68
Solana wallets have $0.00 balance across all three wallet configs
Primary has $1,070 on Base, Wallet B has $733 on Arbitrum
ML optimizer loaded 591 closed trades but 0 usable (not enough recent data) → static weights

what_went_well: IS_PAPER dynamic mode fix confirmed working: PositionMonitor initialized (mode=LIVE)
f-string syntax error in arb_executor.py caught and fixed before CI could deploy
Scanner finding high-scoring gems (up to 100.0) — scoring engine is healthy
Safety checks running: SAFE/CAUTION verdicts flowing correctly
All 4 Docker containers healthy: bot, dashboard, db, health
what_went_wrong: The sell pipeline overhaul (3 Manus prompts) introduced an f-string syntax error that broke arb_executor
CI/CD lint-and-test failed on 238bfb5 (Manus commit) — blocked the deploy job
Zero trades for 2.5 hours despite active scanning — capital/chain mismatch
Solana completely unfunded — an entire execution avenue is dead
key_insights.root_cause: Market alpha concentration on Ethereum (where no wallet is configured) + Conservative min_gem_score=68 filtering out most Base gems that score 60-76 + zero Solana balance

patterns_extracted.description: When most alpha wallet signals target a chain that has been disabled (Ethereum), the entire copy-trade pipeline produces zero trades. The Hyperliquid perps fallback partially addresses this but has its own min_gem_score gate (70) that further filters.
patterns_extracted.action: Either lower Hyperliquid gate to match market signal quality (62-65), re-enable Ethereum on a wallet, or find Base/Arbitrum-specific alpha sources.

patterns_extracted.description: Conservative min_gem_score=68 works for Ethereum mainnet tokens but is too high for Base/Arbitrum L2 gems which typically score 60-76 due to less liquidity depth and fewer data signals. L2-specific gems need a lower threshold (62-65) to execute.
patterns_extracted.action: Consider chain-specific min_gem_score overrides: Base=62, Arbitrum=65, Solana=58 (already set)

patterns_extracted.description: Manus AI commits sometimes contain Python syntax errors (e.g., nested double quotes in f-strings). Always run `ast.parse()` on every modified file after merging Manus PRs, before deploying.
patterns_extracted.action: Add ast.parse() validation to CI lint step or create a pre-deploy hook

user_feedback.comments: User skeptical that bot is really running — asked for deep VPS health check. Discovered zero trades executing despite scanner activity.
